_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 windows producing a ±2 score move and no clean breaker named by either brain, HOLD is the statistically honest call — the coil resolves when a confirmed breaker emerges, not on a guess.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with Disbelief as forward phase; narrative writer implies a directional UP move via accumulation framing but does not name a specific breaker, creating a split between statistical caution and narrative optimism.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $67K with funding below 0.015% and DXY breaks below 99.0
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC closes below $62K with VIX spiking above 20 and funding turning negative
